PUNE, India , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- QKS Group announced today that it has named AuraQuantic as a leader in the SPARK Matrixâ¢: Low Code Application Development Platform for Business Developers, 2026 .
According to Nikhilesh Naik , Associate Director, Research, QKS Group, "AuraQuantic's differentiation in the Low-Code Application Development Platform market for Business Developers lies in its ability to provide a comprehensive no-code environment in which business users can move from application requirements to functional enterprise applications with limited dependence on traditional programming. The platform brings together visual application design, responsive forms, data structures, business rules, reusable components, document handling, dashboards, notifications, role-based access, and integration assets within a common development environment. This enables business developers to build applications that extend beyond basic forms and departmental use cases while maintaining consistency across application logic, data, user experience, and governance. Reusable fields, forms, rules, templates, and application components further help organizations standardize development practices and accelerate the creation of applications across multiple business functions."
"AuraQuantic also provides an effective governance model for scaling business-led application development across the enterprise. Business developers can configure application behaviour, interfaces, rules, data models, and approved integrations, while IT teams retain control over identity, security, environments, enterprise integrations, and deployment standards. Capabilities including real-time model validation, development and production environment separation, version management, selective synchronization, role-based permissions, auditability, and flexible deployment options help organizations expand low-code development without compromising application control. AuraQuantic's continued investments in AI-assisted application development, next-generation user interfaces, reusable development assets, lifecycle automation, and application governance further strengthen its ability to support enterprise-wide low-code development. The combination of no-code productivity, application depth, reuse, governance, and enterprise deployment capabilities has enabled AuraQuantic to regain its position as a Leader in the SPARK Matrixâ¢: Low-Code Application Development Platform for Business Developers, 2026," Nikhilesh adds.

AuraQuantic's No-Code capabilities extend well beyond application development, covering data management, business rules, interface design, reusable components and application integration. This enables organizations to standardize application development across business areas while empowering non-technical teams to build and evolve their own solutions." - Pablo Trilles, CEO of AuraQuantic
